title: Apple App Store Search Scraper
description: Search the Apple App Store for app names, publishers, prices, ratings, categories, and links. Submit several search phrases in one run to build catalogs or compare storefront listings.

batch.title: Search queries
batch.description: App Store search phrases. Add one object per phrase.
batch.valueDescription: query used to run this search.

schema.description: Search term (q is accepted as an alias)
Store vertical: apps, mac, books, audiobooks, movies, tv, music, or podcasts
Two-letter Apple storefront country code (default: us)

results.title: Pocket Notes: Daily Planner
results.description: Organize daily tasks, quick notes, and reminders in one simple planner.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Apple App Store Search | App Listings
storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Apple App Store apps by keyword for titles, developers, ratings, prices, and links. Build product catalogs and compare listings across storefronts.
storeCopy.intro: Search App Store listings with one or more phrases. Collect app identity, developer, pricing, rating, release, and storefront fields for catalog and market analysis.
useCases: App discovery teams can build localized catalogs of available apps.
Product marketers can compare competitor ratings, prices, and release history.
App publishers can monitor how listings appear across storefronts.
howToUse: Add one search phrase to `queries` for each App Store search.
Run the Actor and export result rows from its dataset.

faqs.question: Can I search storefronts outside the United States?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set `country` to the two-letter App Store country code and choose a supported store type.

relatedActors.title: Apple App Store App Details Scraper

fields.name: id
fields.description: Apple product ID assigned to the app in the selected storefront.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Apple storefront record type for the app listing.

fields.name: title
fields.description: App name displayed on the Apple App Store product page.

fields.name: artist
fields.description: Developer or publisher name shown on the app listing.

fields.name: artist_id
fields.description: Apple developer account ID associated with the listing.

fields.name: description
fields.description: App description displayed in the selected App Store storefront.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Public Apple App Store product page URL for the app.

fields.name: artwork
fields.description: Image URL for the app icon or storefront artwork.

fields.name: genres
fields.description: App Store categories assigned to the product.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Current app price in the selected storefront currency.

fields.name: formatted_price
fields.description: Localized price label displayed in the storefront.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency code used for the listed price.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Average customer rating on the App Store five-star scale.

fields.name: rating_count
fields.description: Number of customer ratings recorded for the app.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: App release date reported by the storefront, in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Current app version listed by the storefront.

fields.name: content_rating
fields.description: Age guidance or content rating assigned to the app.

fields.name: seller
fields.description: Seller name printed on the App Store product page.

fields.name: input_query
fields.description: Search phrase used to find this App Store listing.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this app listing was collected.
